verdict.rationale: LightSprint documents background cloud agents that work through tasks autonomously, plus reusable workflows that turn repeatable software work into routines moving from request to review with less manual coordination. These are first-party but marketing-level claims, and there is no evidence of scheduled, recurring or event-triggered automations that run unattended. Missing for 10: recurring schedules or event triggers for automations, documentation of how automations are configured, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
